text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's morning on White Day, and I meet
with
Mihono Bourbon to give her some
marshmallows
as a return gift for
Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: ブルボン！それ、バレンタインのお返し！
choice_data_list_en: Bourbon! That's your Valentine's return gift!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: 中身はマシュマロだよ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bing-bong, bang-bong!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes...
choice_data_list: えーと……それじゃ、また午後に！
choice_data_list_en: Umm... well then, see you this afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That was strange. I expected her to be
more
enthusiastic about the gift. I
wonder if something
is wrong.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So yesterday, I saw someone buying

marshmallows as a present for White
Day...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yikes, guess they were trying to send a
hint. They
say you're not supposed to
gift marshmallows to
people you're close
with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No wonder Mihono Bourbon reacted the
way she
did! She must've been so
disappointed. I have to
right this wrong
somehow!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Huh? An amusement park?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After training, I invite Mihono Bourbon
to an
amusement park as extra thanks
for her
Valentine's Day gift.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In that case, I will go change.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The amusement park at night...
Status—"excited."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What should we go on first?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: ジェットコースターに乗ろう！

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Status—"!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It appears we must solve a puzzle to
unlock this
gate. Commencing mission.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clatter! Clatter!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I did not anticipate that you would be
this
frightened.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you are scared, go ahead and hold on
to me.
Activating escort mode.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
What shall we ride next? Checking
records for
attractions we have not yet
ridden...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's having fun. What a
relief!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have identified that I am having
"fun."
choice_data_list: 楽しんでもらえてよかった

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am experiencing...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
An error has occurred... Could not
retrieve
suitable term for response.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I was happy when you gave me a return
gift.
However... I detected a discrepancy
between my
feelings and that
description.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
When I received your marshmallows, it
did not
feel sufficient to simply express
my gratitude. I
have been searching for
what to say to you since.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I wore my Valentine's Day outfit to
express the
feeling, but even this is far
from adequate in
communicating my
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... How am I supposed to express
this
emotion?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that even if the words don't
feel exactly
right to her, I'm sure her
feelings will still come
through loud and
clear.
choice_data_list: 思いのままに言葉を並べて
choice_data_list_en: Let the words flow straight from your heart.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see... Suggestion acknowledged. I will
do my
best.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for the gift. It
made me very
happy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm detecting a critical error in language

processing. When I look at you, words
keep
disappearing from my memory!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No words are sufficient. I cannot convey
how I
feel...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I assure her I can read her pure joy from
her
expression and general mood.
choice_data_list_en: Your feelings came through loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Truly? Was I really able to convey them?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please tell me what it is I

communicated. Verbalize in clear terms
the
feelings which I attempted to
express just now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Transmission system stable and secure. I
am ready
for your answer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try rearranging words and phrases in a
million
ways until Mihono Bourbon is
satisfied. It makes
me realize just how
happy she truly is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If her feelings can't be expressed with
words,
maybe she can use her body
language to make
things clearer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Body language... I will do my best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She begins doing a strange dance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Transmission failed!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I presumed I would be able to convey
my feelings
through a dance as I can in a
winning concert, but
it did not work...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Solution found! I believe it will be
easier for you
to comprehend my
feelings if we dance together,
just like in
a winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, will you join me in a dance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a little embarrassing, but I agree to
do it for
her sake. We both begin
dancing in unison.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Are my feelings transmitting properly?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon looks at me with such
warmth in
her eyes that it feels as if I get
a glimpse right
into her heart.
